summary: Aterian filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Contingent Value Rights Agreement with Broadridge as Rights Agent. The CVRs were distributed as a dividend to holders of common stock and certain warrants as of July 8, 2026. Each CVR entitles holders to payments from proceeds of asset sales, stock sale net proceeds, escrow releases, and other sources after specified obligations. No dollar amount, per-share price, or premium stated. The CVRs represent a return of capital mechanism contingent on future monetization events. Watch for actual asset sale proceeds and timing of distributions.
